title: DCP-AI canonicalization candidate corpus
status: NON-NORMATIVE PROPOSAL. Not a conformance requirement; no SDK implements or accepts this profile.

provenance.source: Corpus revision 2 of the dcp-jcs-v2 candidate, as approved for the design closure
provenance.changed: Only "proposal" (now this repository's public proposal) and this "provenance" field. Cases, profile_selection_cases, policy_cases, domain, reject_classes and how_to_read are unchanged.

how_to_read.file: This file is ASCII JSON. Decode it with any JSON parser first.
how_to_read.input_json: After decoding, the exact JSON text to feed to the ingress function, encoded as UTF-8. Escapes such as \ud800 are part of that text.
how_to_read.input_hex: Used instead of input_json when the input bytes are not valid UTF-8 or start with a byte order mark.
how_to_read.input_sha256: SHA-256 of the input bytes, to confirm a harness built them correctly.
how_to_read.canonical: After decoding, the expected canonical text; its UTF-8 encoding is the signed or hashed byte string.
how_to_read.canonical_sha256: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical bytes.
how_to_read.input_escapes: Hex digits of the u-escapes the input contains literally; such inputs are pure ASCII. A harness can assert both before running the case.
how_to_read.reject_class: Every reject case has exactly one defect, so the class is checkable.
how_to_read.needs_original_bytes: true when at least one of the four SDK parsers turns the input into a value that passes object-level checks; only an ingress check on the original bytes can reject it.

domain.max_depth_scope: Counted over the whole input document, including any bundle envelope: a payload inside a signed bundle starts at depth 4.
domain.key_order: ascending Unicode code point (not RFC 8785 UTF-16 order)

reject_classes.UTF8_INVALID: Input bytes are not well-formed UTF-8.
reject_classes.SURROGATE_UNPAIRED: A \u escape names a surrogate that is not part of a high-low pair.
reject_classes.DUPLICATE_KEY: Two members of one object have the same key after unescaping.
reject_classes.NUMBER_NOT_INTEGER: The exact decimal value of a number literal is not an integer.
reject_classes.NUMBER_OUT_OF_RANGE: The exact value is an integer outside [-(2^53-1), 2^53-1], or the literal overflows.
reject_classes.DEPTH_EXCEEDED: More than 64 nested arrays and objects in the whole input document.
